transportRole: internal Body runtime transport; not the product's primary command port

authentication.debugClient: 256-bit local token from daemon/profiles/.auth/client.token or BODY_DEBUG_TOKEN
authentication.extension: trust-on-first-use pairing bound to extensionInstanceId + runtimeExtensionId; paired token stored in chrome.storage.local

controllerPolicy.debugClient: diagnostic/test only; mutating commands rejected while Brain is attached
controllerPolicy.daemonConsole: diagnostic/test only; mutating commands rejected while Brain is attached
controllerPolicy.bodyRuntime: continues recording and learning with or without Brain

debugClient.purpose: manual smoke testing and diagnostics only

browserUi.resultTruth: delivered, observed effect, verified and taskSuccess are separate concepts

hello.token: paired token or null on first pairing
